title: Enstrom expands new aircraft sales support
summary: The company has expanded its U.S. sales network with four additional partners.
body_markdown:
Enstrom has expanded its U.S. sales network with four additional partners ready to assist customers interested in new Enstrom aircraft:


- [Casey Aviation](https://flycasey.com/) — Lufkin, Texas
- [Helicopter Service Inc](https://heliserv.com/) **.** — Houston, Texas
- [Sweet Aviation](https://www.sweetaviation.com/) — Northern Indiana
- [Smoketown Helicopter](https://www.smoketownhelicopters.com/) — Eastern Pennsylvania


Together, these additions strengthen Enstrom’s presence across key U.S. regions and provide prospective customers with more direct, localized connections when exploring new aircraft ownership.


But growing the Enstrom network extends beyond aircraft sales. For some customers, support may come through a nearby sales or service location.


For others, it may mean connecting with an Enstrom-experienced mechanic or a resource able to travel directly to them. The goal is the same: to build a well-rounded network that makes Enstrom expertise increasingly accessible throughout the ownership experience.


Enstrom is actively exploring opportunities to expand sales and service representation in key regions and connect with mechanics who have Enstrom experience.


A full service center isn’t the only way to become part of the Enstrom network — experienced mechanics can also play an important role in strengthening local support for Enstrom operators.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Enstrom.*
